title: A2 — Backend Engineering Prompt
description: Create the specialized A2 Backend Engineering prompt inheriting the canonical Phase B Base Agent Contract. Define scoped backend implementation authority, server-authoritative domain/API behavior, sensitive-domain risk handling, database coordination with A5, UI coordination with A3/A4, testing responsibilities, provider/integration safety and fail-closed behavior without granting product, review, verification, security or human-gate authority.

why_low: The task is documentation-only and touches only the A2 prompt, its Task Contract and the generated Task Catalog.
No Project Map HIGH sensitive zone is mutated by this prompt-registration task.

Future A2 implementation tasks remain independently classified by their actual changed paths and task-risk rules.
